description.value: Tekkaba is a Japanese restaurant on East Cordova Street in Vancouver, specializing in Kaiseki-style Omakase and traditional Izakaya cuisine, established by Pacific Dream Group. The space is decorated with Korean paintings and egg crafts donated by artist Gyungja Jung in support of a social welfare initiative, giving the dining room a distinctive cultural character. Multi-course Omakase dinners are offered in two evening seatings, with reservations strongly recommended.
